newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone up, options action sparks bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone up, options action sparks bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Vodafone Plc jumped higher late morning on Thursday as a burst of activity in the options market fanned a spate of bid speculation, dealers said.
"There is talk about a possible German bidder for Vodafone but it's just speculation at the moment," one options trader said. "The Vodafone options pit is packed."
Added the head of equity trading at one leading brokerage: "There is a lot of dealing in the options market and there are rumours of a bid."
The stock was up 15p at 293-1/2 by 1159 GMT in active trade of 8.1 million shares, after earlier rising as high as 300p.
In the same sector Orange Plc was up 4-1/2p at 207-1/2.
In Vodafone options the April 280 calls were the most active series, quoted at 28p bid, 32p offer, up from an opening at 14p bid, 18p offer.
No-one at Vodafone was immediately available for comment.
-- David Holmes and Dale Faulken, London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
